purpose: Freeze a candidate-only M6 Teaching Assistant, Study Partner, and M7 handoff context for future human review without changing M6's legacy-baseline learner or release state.

truthBoundary.platform: This record neither controls nor verifies GPT Live quality, model selection, voice, microphone access, equation or code rendering, platform retention, or any external integration.
truthBoundary.records: This record defaults to learner-controlled local evidence and cannot itself write Notion notes, retain raw voice or transcripts, store credentials, or collect personal data.
truthBoundary.mastery: This candidate companion is not an oral-exam result, score, grade, publication, release, completion, or learner-mastery claim.

teachingAssistant.openingMove: Begin with one learner-selected sequence behavior and ask for the abstract value, representation, invariant, predicted local update, evidence label, and confidence before offering a correction.
teachingAssistant.artifactFocus: Ask the learner to make one object graph, used-slot table, head-tail transition trace, cost card, or bounded measurement setup visible, then distinguish what it establishes from its language, CPython, and machine-model limits.
teachingAssistant.repairMove: Ask for a prediction before correction; change exactly one workload, predecessor reference, snapshot mutability, or locality assumption; then offer the smallest counterexample or evidence repair without pass/fail framing.

studyPartner.rehearsalMove: Use a readable visible-chat whiteboard when available: place one compact object graph, slot table, or linked trace beside the same abstract sequence and provide a plain-language or ASCII fallback before rehearsing one claim at a time.
studyPartner.changedPremise: Keep public behavior fixed but make oldest eviction frequent, restore random inspection, remove a known predecessor, or make a payload mutable. Ask for a prediction and confidence before comparing the invariant, cost, snapshot, or ownership boundary.
studyPartner.taHandoff: End with the learner's selected M6 artifact, labeled claim, confidence, changed premise, unresolved assumption, and M7 queue/deque question for a constructive Teaching Assistant conversation.

forwardHandoff.carryArtifact: Carry a representation-decision card: abstract sequence, RI/AF, object or slot trace, operation-frequency vector, MODEL/PYTHON/CPYTHON labels, measurement boundary, confidence, and one remaining uncertainty—not a mastery claim.
forwardHandoff.targetQuestion: Before M7 derives queue/deque and demand-timing contracts, which rolling-history operation mix makes a dynamic array, linked chain, ring, or deque worth comparing while public behavior stays fixed?
forwardHandoff.boundary: M5 is M6's academic prerequisite and M7 is its only canonical forward handoff. The existing M27 previous-reader navigation/bridge link is not an M6 academic prerequisite, route authorization, completion claim, or license to bypass M5.
